'''''Renhoek''''' was a [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser|MC80 ''Liberty'' type]] [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] in service to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Behind the scenes==
The name ''Renhoek'' is similar to "Ren Höek," a lead character from the cartoon series ''[[Wikipedia:The Ren & Stimpy Show|Ren & Stimpy]]''. The vessel shared its name with a [[Renhoek (transports)|group]] of [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|transports]]. The transports were assigned to the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] ''[[Stimsenj'kat]]'',<ref name="XWCD">[[Star Wars: X-Wing Collector's CD-ROM|''Star Wars: X-Wing'' Collector's CD-ROM]]</ref> whose name is similar to "Stimpson J. Cat," the series' other lead character.
